caption: The drawing depicts a golden-colored eagle with outstretched wings positioned above a stylized American flag. The eagle is shown facing forward and downwards, with its talons gripping the draped flag. The flag features red and white vertical stripes and blue triangular sections in the upper corners, each containing white stars. The flag is fixed on a pole at either end, both tipped with gold spearheads. Below the eagle’s talons and flag is a small, gold-colored ribbon that appears to be a banner but has no visible text. The background is plain and off-white, and the composition centers the eagle and flag dominantly in the image.
title: Eagle Sternpiece
